title: Prior Low Touch by Open Location
summary: How often the session reached the prior session's low, given where it opened inside the prior range — by default, opens in the lower half (open position at most 0.5, where 0 is the prior low and 1 the prior high). The denominator is sessions with a prior range that opened inside the chosen band; the numerator is the ones that traded at or below the prior low. As with the prior-high twin, opens nearer the level are mechanically closer to touching it — separate that geometry from behavior before drawing conclusions.

params.name: maxOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at most this far up the prior range (0 = prior low, 1 = prior high).

params.name: minOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at least this far up the prior range.
